source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Original citation restored 6 Nov 2026 (the 5 Nov verification had moved it because of a text-cleaning fault).

note: Triennial election of the 19 electoral divisions of Dungannon rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Twelve Unionists and five Nationalists were returned unopposed; Crossdernott and Coalisland were contested. The new council had thirteen Unionists and six Nationalists, with three members to be co-opted. In place of H. A. M'Minn. Returned unopposed.
